logger.doc:name: Runtime fingerprint
logger.message: #["Runtime fingerprint check | env=" ++ (p("env") default "unknown") ++ " | buildSha=" ++ (p("build.sha") default "manual-or-unknown")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { application: "universal-banking-birthday-wishes-notification-api", environment: p("env") default "unknown", buildSha: p("build.sha") default "manual-or-unknown", configSource: "config/" ++ ((p("env") default "unknown") as String) ++ ".yaml", runtime: "Mule 4.9.0", timestamp: now() }

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load dashboard metrics
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CUSTOMERS, COUNT_IF(MONTH(DATEOFBIRTH) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()) AND DAY(DATEOFBIRTH) = DAY(CURRENT_DATE())) AS BIRTHDAYS_TODAY, COUNT_IF(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE) = YEAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)) AS BIRTHDAY_WISHES_SENT, COUNT_IF(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS SENT_LAST_30_DAYS, COUNT_IF(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE IS NULL OR YEAR(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE) < YEAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE)) AS PENDING FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load upcoming customers
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT FULLNAME, ACCOUNTNUMBER, DATEOFBIRTH, EMAIL, BANKNAME, BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT, BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, DATEOFBIRTH, CURRENT_DATE()), DATEOFBIRTH) BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATEADD(day, 30, CURRENT_DATE()) OR DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, DATEOFBIRTH, CURRENT_DATE()) + 1, DATEOFBIRTH) BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATEADD(day, 30, CURRENT_DATE()) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN DATE_PART('DOY', DATEOFBIRTH) >= DATE_PART('DOY', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE) THEN DATE_PART('DOY', DATEOFBIRTH) ELSE DATE_PART('DOY', DATEOFBIRTH) + 366 END

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load daily sent counts
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT TO_DATE(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE) AS SENT_DATE, COUNT(*) AS SENT_COUNT FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE >= DATEADD(day, -29, CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY TO_DATE(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE) ORDER BY SENT_DATE

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load monthly birthday counts
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT MONTH(DATEOFBIRTH) AS BIRTHDAY_MONTH, COUNT(*) AS BIRTHDAY_COUNT FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY MONTH(DATEOFBIRTH) ORDER BY BIRTHDAY_MONTH

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var metrics = vars.metrics var customers = [] --- { source: "Snowflake", generatedAt: now(), metrics: { totalCustomers: (metrics.TOTAL_CUSTOMERS default 0) as Number, birthdaysToday: (metrics.BIRTHDAYS_TODAY default 0) as Number, birthdayWishesSent: (metrics.BIRTHDAY_WISHES_SENT default 0) as Number, sentLast30Days: (metrics.SENT_LAST_30_DAYS default 0) as Number, pending: (metrics.PENDING default 0) as Number }, sentByDay: vars.dailySent map (d) -> {date: d.SENT_DATE, count: (d.SENT_COUNT default 0) as Number}, monthlyBirthdays: vars.monthlyBirthdays map (m) -> {month: (m.BIRTHDAY_MONTH default 0) as Number, count: (m.BIRTHDAY_COUNT default 0) as Number}, customers: [] } ++ { customers: (vars.upcomingCustomers default []) map (c) -> { name: c.FULLNAME, account: c.ACCOUNTNUMBER, birthday: c.DATEOFBIRTH, email: c.EMAIL, bankName: c.BANKNAME, sent: c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT default false, sentDate: c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE } }

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load all active customers
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT FULLNAME, ACCOUNTNUMBER, DATEOFBIRTH, EMAIL, BANKNAME, BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT, BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE, STATUS FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY FULLNAME

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { source: "Snowflake", generatedAt: now(), count: sizeOf(payload), customers: payload map (c) -> { name: c.FULLNAME, account: c.ACCOUNTNUMBER, birthday: c.DATEOFBIRTH, email: c.EMAIL, bankName: c.BANKNAME, status: c.STATUS, sent: c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT default false, sentDate: c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE } }

snowflake:select.doc:name: Select birthday candidates
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,FULLNAME,DATEOFBIRTH,MOBILENUMBER,BANKNAME,EMAIL, TO_CHAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE FROM BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA WHERE MONTH(DATEOFBIRTH)=MONTH(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE) AND DAY(DATEOFBIRTH)=DAY(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE) AND STATUS='ACTIVE' AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND (BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE IS NULL OR YEAR(BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE)<YEAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::DATE))

snowflake:update.doc:name: Create notification if absent
snowflake:update.snowflake:sql: MERGE INTO BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX t USING ( SELECT :notificationId AS NOTIFICATION_ID,:customerId AS CUSTOMER_ID,'BIRTHDAY_EMAIL' AS NOTIFICATION_TYPE, :businessDate AS BUSINESS_DATE,:fullname AS FULLNAME,:email AS EMAIL,:bankName AS BANKNAME,:mobileNumber AS MOBILENUMBER ) s ON t.NOTIFICATION_ID=s.NOTIFICATION_ID WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (NOTIFICATION_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,NOTIFICATION_TYPE,BUSINESS_DATE,FULLNAME,EMAIL,BANKNAME,MOBILENUMBER,STATUS,ATTEMPT_COUNT,NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT,CREATED_AT,UPDATED_AT) VALUES (s.NOTIFICATION_ID,s.CUSTOMER_ID,s.NOTIFICATION_TYPE,s.BUSINESS_DATE,s.FULLNAME,s.EMAIL,s.BANKNAME,s.MOBILENUMBER,'PENDING',0,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())

logger.doc:name: Outbox scan complete
logger.message: BIRTHDAY OUTBOX | candidate scan completed; workers will claim records independently.

snowflake:select.doc:name: Load pending notification work
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT NOTIFICATION_ID,CUSTOMER_ID,FULLNAME,EMAIL,BANKNAME,MOBILENUMBER,STATUS,ATTEMPT_COUNT FROM BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX WHERE (STATUS='PENDING' AND (NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT IS NULL OR NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) OR (STATUS='CLAIMED' AND LEASE_UNTIL<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) ORDER BY CREATED_AT LIMIT 25

snowflake:update.doc:name: Acquire lease
snowflake:update.snowflake:sql: UPDATE BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX SET STATUS='CLAIMED',OWNER=:owner,LEASE_UNTIL=DATEADD('minute',5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), ATTEMPT_COUNT=COALESCE(ATTEMPT_COUNT,0)+1,UPDATED_AT=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID=:notificationId AND ((STATUS='PENDING' AND (NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT IS NULL OR NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) OR (STATUS='CLAIMED' AND LEASE_UNTIL<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))

snowflake:select.doc:name: Verify lease owner
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT OWNER,STATUS FROM BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID=:notificationId

<set-payload value="#[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "

Warm Birthday Wishes from " ++ (vars.bankName default "Our Bank") ++ ".
May this day bring happiness, success, good health, and prosperity.
Thank you for choosing us as your trusted banking partner.
Have a wonderful birthday! 🎂
Regards,
Customer Relationship Team"]" doc:name="Build HTML email"/>

snowflake:update.doc:name: Mark notification sent
snowflake:update.snowflake:sql: UPDATE BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX SET STATUS='SENT',SENT_AT=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),LEASE_UNTIL=NULL,LAST_ERROR=NULL,UPDATED_AT=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID=:notificationId AND OWNER=:owner

snowflake:update.doc:name: Release failed notification for retry
snowflake:update.snowflake:sql: UPDATE BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX SET STATUS='PENDING',OWNER=NULL,LEASE_UNTIL=NULL,NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=DATEADD('minute',5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()),LAST_ERROR=:lastError,UPDATED_AT=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE NOTIFICATION_ID=:notificationId AND OWNER=:owner

snowflake:select.doc:name: Find sent notifications missing customer flag
snowflake:select.snowflake:sql: SELECT o.CUSTOMER_ID FROM BANK_NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX o LEFT JOIN BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID=o.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE o.STATUS='SENT' AND o.NOTIFICATION_TYPE='BIRTHDAY_EMAIL' AND (c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE IS NULL OR c.BIRTHDAY_WISH_SENT_DATE<o.SENT_AT) LIMIT 100
